chunks: They said: "Put him and his brother off awhile, and send summoners to the cities to gather"
ai.seo_question: What advice did Pharaoh's court give regarding Musa and Harun?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, Pharaoh's advisors propose a strategic delay in executing Musa and Harun to allow time for gathering skilled magicians from across Egypt, highlighting the political maneuvering behind the divine confrontation. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the 'Hawashir' (gatherers) as representatives of the elite class who sought to validate Pharaoh's authority through supernatural competition. The delay underscores the temporary nature of worldly power before the ultimate triumph of truth.
